title: Emissions-funded yield masquerading as revenue
summary: Staking APY that depends on scheduled emissions rather than modeled protocol revenue can create reflexive sell pressure and must be flagged before launch-readiness claims.

title: Unlock cliffs hidden behind allocation words
summary: A plan can mention vesting and unlocks while still concentrating too much supply in one cliff; require arithmetic evidence for cliff size and liquidity pressure.

title: Guaranteed ROI language
summary: Guaranteed ROI, return, upside, APY, or buyer-profit language must block planner approval unless rewritten as bounded analysis with qualified review.
